objective: I can practice asking an adult about a signal. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: The learner recalls one specific body signal noticed earlier this week that went unmentioned at the time, and practices saying a three-part script out loud, as if telling a trusted adult about that exact signal right now.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u04-l06-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u04-l06-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u04-l06-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u04-l06-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Describe which of the three parts felt hardest, naming the signal, describing when it started, or stating what you need, and explain why.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u04-l06-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u04-l06-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u04-l06-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Script completeness: The script includes all three parts in order. | Recall specificity: The learner names a specific signal and roughly when it happened. | Transfer to a new signal: The learner writes a complete three-part script for a new signal. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u04-l06-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner teach the three-part script to someone else by writing out an example conversation that uses all three parts for a brand-new signal.

resources.title: asking an adult about a signal coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The learner recalls one specific body signal noticed earlier this week that went unmentioned at the time, and practices saying a three-part script out loud, as if telling a trusted adult about that exact signal right now.
Coach direction: Think back over the past several days and pick one signal you remember but did not mention out loud at the time.
Learner prompt: Name the specific signal you noticed but did not mention, such as hunger, thirst, tiredness, needing a bathroom break, or feeling too hot or cold, and about when it happened.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: asking an adult about a signal complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Practice saying the three-part script out loud for the signal you named: name the signal, describe when it started, state what you need.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I said the signal's name first, for example, 'I feel thirsty.'
Response 2 (t2-p2): I described when it started, for example, 'since we came inside.'
Response 3 (t2-p3): I stated what I need, for example, 'can I get a drink of water.'
Response 4 (t2-p4): I practiced saying all three parts in order without skipping one.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: asking an adult about a signal minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Describe which of the three parts felt hardest, naming the signal, describing when it started, or stating what you need, and explain why.

Success checks: Script completeness: The script includes all three parts in order. | Recall specificity: The learner names a specific signal and roughly when it happened. | Transfer to a new signal: The learner writes a complete three-part script for a new signal.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: asking an adult about a signal supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g3-u04-l06-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g3-u04-l06-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional asking an adult about a signal condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Script completeness: The script includes all three parts in order. | Recall specificity: The learner names a specific signal and roughly when it happened. | Transfer to a new signal: The learner writes a complete three-part script for a new signal..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u04-l06-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.

safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.
